objective: Definir en el dominio Cavas las invariantes de Cava Física, Asignación temporal y Membresía, sin DDL ni cambios de persistencia. La identidad física de la cava debe ser estable y separada de la ocupación temporal. Una cava física no puede tener más de una asignación activa al mismo tiempo. Las membresías pertenecen a la asignación, no directamente a la cava física. Soportar TITULAR y COMPLEMENTARIO sin hardcodear cantidades máximas ni políticas de derechos. No inventar Entidad_Catalogo; usar referencias opacas a la identidad canónica existente.

import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    CavaAssignment,
    CavaAssignmentStatus,
    CavaMembership,
    MembershipRole,
    PhysicalCavaIdentity,
    validate_cava_assignment,
    validate_cava_membership,
    validate_physical_cava_identity,
    validate_single_active_assignment,
)


def test_physical_cava_has_stable_identity_independent_of_assignment():
    cava = PhysicalCavaIdentity(cava_id="CAVA-1", empresa_id="EMP-1", unidad_negocio_id="UNIT-1", stable_code="CAVA-001")
    validate_physical_cava_identity(cava)
    assert not hasattr(cava, "membership_id")
    assert not hasattr(cava, "canonical_client_id")


def test_active_assignment_is_temporal_occupancy_not_physical_identity():
    assignment = CavaAssignment(assignment_id="ASG-1", cava_id="CAVA-1", status=CavaAssignmentStatus.ACTIVA, valid_from="2026-09-06")
    validate_cava_assignment(assignment)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_cava_assignment(CavaAssignment(assignment_id="ASG-2", cava_id="CAVA-1", status=CavaAssignmentStatus.ACTIVA, valid_from="2026-09-06", valid_to="2026-12-31"))


def test_only_one_active_assignment_per_physical_cava():
    assignments = [
        CavaAssignment(assignment_id="ASG-1", cava_id="CAVA-1", status=CavaAssignmentStatus.ACTIVA, valid_from="2026-01-01"),
        CavaAssignment(assignment_id="ASG-2", cava_id="CAVA-1", status=CavaAssignmentStatus.ACTIVA, valid_from="2026-02-01"),
    ]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_single_active_assignment(assignments)


def test_membership_belongs_to_assignment_not_directly_to_physical_cava():
    membership = CavaMembership(membership_id="MEM-1", assignment_id="ASG-1", canonical_client_id="CLIENT-1", role=MembershipRole.TITULAR)
    validate_cava_membership(membership)
    assert not hasattr(membership, "cava_id")


def test_complementary_membership_requires_titular_link():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_cava_membership(CavaMembership(membership_id="MEM-2", assignment_id="ASG-1", canonical_client_id="CLIENT-2", role=MembershipRole.COMPLEMENTARIO))
    validate_cava_membership(CavaMembership(membership_id="MEM-2", assignment_id="ASG-1", canonical_client_id="CLIENT-2", role=MembershipRole.COMPLEMENTARIO, titular_membership_id="MEM-1"))


def test_domain_does_not_hardcode_member_counts_or_bottle_capacity():
    fields = CavaMembership.__dataclass_fields__
    assert "max_members" not in fields
    assert "max_bottles" not in fields
